doc:
### PROPOSAL-21 — Depth Map - **slug**: `depth-map` - **Vibe**: A sensor's point-cloud view of the app — surfaces colored by distance, luminous cyan-to-magenta gradients marking near-to-far, wireframe contours on hover. - **Best for**: Analytics dashboards and the shooting board — literal visual depth for information priority. Adjectives: technical, luminous, dimensional. - **Palette** (dark theme, `is_dark: true`): | Token | Value | Usage | |---|---|---| | `--bg-canvas` | `#04070e` | Sensor-black void | | `--bg-surface` | `#0a1120` | Near-field panel fill | | `--bg-surface-elevated` | `#111b33` | Closer/higher-priority fill | | `--border-subtle` | `#1a2745` | Contour hairlines | | `--border-default` | `#2a3c66` | Standard borders | | `--border-focus` | `#4ef0ff` | Sensor-cyan focus outline | | `--text-primary` | `#e8f4ff` | Near-white headings (closest) | | `--text-secondary` | `#a8c4e8` | Mid-field body text | | `--text-muted` | `#5c739c` | Far-field dim text | | `--color-action` | `#4ef0ff` | Cyan = nearest action | | `--color-action-hover` | `#38d4e6` | Action hover (deeper cyan) | | `--color-earnings` | `#ff9d4e` | Warm near-IR earnings | | `--color-earnings-hover` | `#e6843a` | Earnings hover (deeper amber) | | `--color-automation` | `#c44eff` | Far-field magenta automation | | `--color-alert` | `#ffd23c` | Hot-return warnings | | `--color-danger` | `#ff4e6a` | Collision-red failed states | | `--color-action-glow` | `rgba(78, 240, 255, 0.18)` | Cyan depth glow | | `--color-earnings-glow` | `rgba(255, 157, 78, 0.16)` | Amber depth glow | | `--color-automation-glow` | `rgba(196, 78, 255, 0.16)` | Magenta depth glow | - **Typography**: Technical instrument type. Display: `"Space Grotesk", "Chakra Petch", sans-serif` at 600-700. Body: `"Inter", system-ui, sans-serif`. Mono: `"JetBrains Mono", monospace` for coordinates, ranges, and IDs. Distance labels like `z=0.4m` accompany depth emphasis. KPIs `tabular-nums`. - **Radii & Borders**: Soft-tech: cards `rounded-lg`, inputs `rounded-md`. 1px borders, and emphasized (near) panels get a gradient left edge (cyan -> transparent) encoding "closest to user". - **Component Patterns**: - **Buttons**: Flat fill with subtle vertical gradient (lighter top = nearer); primary = cyan fill, dark text. Hover raises "z" (translateY -1px + brighter gradient). Focus = 2px cyan outline. - **Cards**: Panel depth = priority: primary cards use `bg-surface-elevated` + gradient edge, secondary cards sit "further" (darker, dimmer text). Hover draws a 1px wireframe contour (outline) over the card. - **Badges/Status**: Depth-coded chips with a small dot: near = filled bright, mid = filled dim, far = outline only. Publishing = a dot that drifts nearer (scale 0.8 -> 1) on a loop. - **Tables**: Rows tinted by column importance — the key column is brightest ("nearest"), supporting columns dimmer ("further"). Hover = contour outline on the row. - **Forms/Inputs**: Flat fields, 1px borders; focused field "comes nearer" (brighter border + slight scale 1.01). Helper text is far-field dim. - **Loading**: A depth-sweep: a soft gradient band travels down the skeleton (near-color cyan, 1.2s loop). Determinate = bar whose fill gradient shifts cyan->magenta. - **Signature detail**: The cyan-near / magenta-far gradient language — priority is literally distance, and everything important glows closer. - **Motion & Animation**: Smooth and parallax-minded: 200-300ms ease-out; elements "arrive from depth" (scale 0.96 -> 1 + brightness 0.7 -> 1). Hover lifts z; leaving settles back. - **Signature Preview Snippet**: ```html
EARNINGS / 30d · z=0.4m $12,480.50
```
